programmes.amount_note: BRIN operates funding schemes for technology-based startups and research commercialisation, including support for startups using BRIN research infrastructure and licensed BRIN intellectual property. Award sizes vary by scheme and are published with each call.
programmes.deadline_note: Calls are published on the BRIN research and innovation funding portal, typically with windows of four to six weeks.
programmes.reopen_note: BRIN publishes multiple funding calls each year across research and innovation schemes. Register on pendanaan-risnov.brin.go.id to receive notification of new calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the BRIN research and innovation funding portal.
Identify an open scheme matching the startup's stage and technology.
Submit the proposal with technical and commercial detail.
Substantive review and presentation.
Contract and disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Proposal with technical and business plan
IP or licensing documentation where BRIN IP is used

eligibility.other_note: Indonesian technology-based startups and research teams. Some schemes require use of BRIN facilities or licensed BRIN intellectual property.

programmes.source_snippet: BRIN menyediakan skema pendanaan riset dan inovasi termasuk untuk startup berbasis teknologi.

programmes.amount_note: A free national founder-education pipeline running from ignition and workshop stages through hacksprint, bootcamp and incubation. No direct cash grant; the value is training, mentoring and incubation placement.
programmes.deadline_note: Runs in annual cycles across multiple Indonesian cities, with registration typically opening in the first half of the year.
programmes.reopen_note: The programme has run annually since 2016 across many cities. Registration for the next cycle opens on 1000startupdigital.id, usually in the first half of the calendar year.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the programme website for the city cohort of interest.
Attend the ignition and workshop stages.
Form a team and progress through hacksprint.
Selected teams enter bootcamp and then incubation.

eligibility.other_note: Open to Indonesian aspiring founders; no company registration required to enter the early stages.

programmes.source_snippet: Gerakan Nasional 1000 Startup Digital is a national movement to create digital founders across Indonesia.

programmes.funder: Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Perekonomian (interest subsidy) delivered through appointed banks
programmes.amount_note: Government interest-subsidised working capital and investment loans delivered through appointed banks. Tiers include KUR Super Mikro (up to IDR 10 million), KUR Mikro (up to IDR 100 million), and KUR Kecil (up to IDR 500 million), at a subsidised annual interest rate (historically 6%).
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling, subject to the annual national KUR ceiling allocated across participating banks.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose a participating bank (for example BRI, Mandiri, BNI, BSI).
Prepare business documents and the loan application.
Bank survey and credit assessment.
Loan approval and disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Proof of at least six months of business operation

eligibility.other_note: Indonesian micro, small and medium enterprises, including unincorporated sole traders, that have been operating for at least six months and are not currently receiving other subsidised programme credit.

programmes.source_snippet: KUR adalah kredit modal kerja dan investasi bagi UMKM dengan suku bunga bersubsidi pemerintah.

programmes.name_en: LPDP RISPRO Innovative Productive Research Funding
programmes.funder: Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan (LPDP), Ministry of Finance
programmes.amount_note: Research commercialisation funding through invitation and competition schemes, with awards historically running into the billions of rupiah per project over up to three years. Requires a research institution as lead and an industry partner.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual or periodic calls announced on the LPDP website, with application windows of several weeks.
programmes.reopen_note: LPDP reissues RISPRO calls periodically, though the scheme structure has been revised across cycles as research funding was consolidated. Check lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id for the current research funding calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Partner with an Indonesian university or research institution as lead applicant.
Prepare the research and commercialisation proposal with the industry partner's commitment.
Submit through the LPDP portal during an open call.
Substantive review and presentation.
Contract and milestone-based disbursement.

documents_required.doc: Letter of commitment from the industry partner

eligibility.other_note: Lead applicant is normally an Indonesian research institution or university; companies participate as industry partners and eventual commercialisation vehicles.

programmes.source_snippet: LPDP mengelola pendanaan riset termasuk skema RISPRO untuk mendorong hilirisasi hasil riset.

programmes.funder: Kementerian Komunikasi dan Digital (Komdigi, formerly Kominfo)
programmes.amount_note: An intensive founder-mentoring programme rather than a cash grant. Selected early-stage startups receive one-to-one coaching from experienced founders and operators, product and growth workshops, and investor exposure at a demo day. No equity is taken.
programmes.deadline_note: Runs in batches, historically two batches per year with applications open for several weeks before each batch.
programmes.reopen_note: The programme has run for multiple batches since 2020. Applications for the next batch are announced on startupstudio.id and Komdigi channels; register on the site for notifications.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online during an open batch call with product and traction details.
Screening based on product-market fit evidence and team.
Interview with the programme team.
Participate in the multi-week coaching and workshop programme.
Present at demo day to investors.

documents_required.doc: Company registration documents (akta pendirian and NIB)

eligibility.other_note: Indonesian digital startups, typically post-product with early traction and a founding team based in Indonesia. Company must be registered in Indonesia (PT).

programmes.source_snippet: Startup Studio Indonesia is a Ministry programme that helps early-stage Indonesian startups achieve product-market fit.
